ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 3.0 (Black) encryptor launch — -pass <32-hex> gate + spread/cleanup flags (BITWISE SPIDER)
ucs.description: Hunts the LockBit 3.0 / LockBit Black encryptor's required `-pass <32-char-hex>` runtime password and its characteristic affiliate switches (-gspd self-spread via GPO, -gdel group-policy cleanup, -psex PsExec spread, -nomutex, -wall wallpaper, -safe reboot-to-safe-mode). The pass-hash gate is unique to LockBit 3.0 builds — virtually no benign software ships a CLI argument shaped like this.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen values(Processes.process) AS cmdlines values(Processes.process_hash) AS hashes values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parents FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.process="* -pass *" OR Processes.process="* -gspd*" OR Processes.process="* -gdel*" OR Processes.process="* -psex *" OR Processes.process="* -nomutex*" OR Processes.process="* -wall *" OR Processes.process="* -safe *") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=cmdlines "(?i)\s-pass\s+(?<lockbit_passhash>[A-Fa-f0-9]{32})\b" | eval flag_hits = mvcount(mvfilter(match(cmdlines,"(?i)\s-(gspd|gdel|psex|nomutex|wall|safe)\b"))) | where isnotnull(lockbit_passhash) OR flag_hits >= 1 | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-pass\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}\b"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(gspd|gdel|psex|nomutex|wall|safe)\b"
| extend PassHash = extract(@"(?i)\s-pass\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{32})\b", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend LockBitFlags = extract_all(@"(?i)\s-(gspd|gdel|psex|nomutex|wall|safe)\b", ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, PassHash, LockBitFlags,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-pass\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}\b"
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(gspd|gdel|psex|nomutex|wall|safe)\b"
| extend PassHash = extract(@"(?i)\s-pass\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{32})\b", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
          ParentProcessName, CommandLine, PassHash
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit 3.0 (Black) Encryptor Launch Flags
id: a3e4b71c-0c4f-4a2d-9c8b-9f3a4b71c0c4
status: experimental
description: Detects LockBit 3.0 / LockBit Black ransomware encryptor execution via its required -pass <32-char-hex> launch gate or characteristic affiliate spread/cleanup switches (-gspd, -gdel, -psex, -nomutex, -wall, -safe). The 32-hex pass gate is unique to LockBit 3.0 builds. CrowdStrike cluster BITWISE SPIDER.
references:
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
    - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/i/lockbit-ransomware-group-augments-its-latest-variant-lockbit-3-0.html
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
    - attack.impact
    - attack.t1486
    - attack.t1490
    - attack.t1562.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_pass:
        CommandLine|re|i: '\s-pass\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}\b'
    selection_flags:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - ' -gspd'
            - ' -gdel'
            - ' -psex '
            - ' -nomutex'
            - ' -wall '
            - ' -safe '
    condition: selection_pass or selection_flags
falsepositives:
    - Unknown — argument shape is not used by legitimate software
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:(*\ -pass\ * AND (*\ -gspd* OR *\ -gdel* OR *\ -psex\ * OR *\ -nomutex* OR *\ -wall\ * OR *\ -safe\ *)) OR @CommandLine:(*\ -gspd* OR *\ -gdel* OR *\ -psex\ *)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/\s-pass\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}\b/i OR CommandLine=/\s-(gspd|gdel|psex|nomutex|wall|safe)\b/i
| PassHash := regex("(?i)\\s-pass\\s+(?<passhash>[A-Fa-f0-9]{32})\\b", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen), collect([CommandLine, PassHash])])
ucs.rationale: LockBit 3.0 / LockBit Black requires a 32-character hex password supplied via the `-pass` switch to even decrypt and run its main routine — a deliberate anti-sandbox control unique to this family. The companion flags `-gspd` (Group Policy spread), `-gdel` (Group Policy delete), `-psex` (PsExec lateral spread), `-wall` (set ransom wallpaper), and `-safe` (safe-mode reboot for unhindered encryption)

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption sabotage chain — VSS / bcdedit / wbadmin / WMI shadow-copy teardown in <5 min
ucs.description: Hunts the LockBit affiliate-playbook pre-encryption teardown sequence: same host, same window, runs 3+ distinct recovery-kill primitives (vssadmin delete shadows, wmic shadowcopy delete, bcdedit recovery disable, wbadmin catalog/systemstatebackup delete, PowerShell Win32_Shadowcopy.Delete). The 3-of-N within 5 min is the LockBit pre-encrypt signature called out in CISA AA23-075A, Mandiant, and SecureWorks (GOLD MYSTIC) reporting and is consistent across LockBit 2.0 / 3.0 / Green / 5.0 builds.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true values(Processes.process) AS cmds values(Processes.process_name) AS tools min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE ( (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*delete /all*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND (Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*delete systemstatebackup*")) OR (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" AND Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*") ) BY Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval sabotage = mvdedup(mvappend( if(match(tools,"(?i)vssadmin\.exe"),"vss_delete",null()), if(match(tools,"(?i)wmic\.exe"),"wmic_vss",null()), if(match(tools,"(?i)bcdedit\.exe"),"bcd_recovery_off",null()), if(match(tools,"(?i)wbadmin\.exe"),"wbadmin_delete",null()), if(match(cmds,"(?i)Win32_Shadowcopy"),"ps_vss",null()) )) | eval distinct_actions = mvcount(sabotage) | where distinct_actions >= 3 | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let WindowSec = 300;
let Tagged = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend SabotageTag = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","delete /all"), "vss_delete",
        FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "wmic_vss",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "bcd_recovery_off",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"), "wbadmin_delete",
        FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "Win32_Shadowcopy", "ps_vss",
        "")
    | where SabotageTag != "";
Tagged
| summarize SabotageActions = make_set(SabotageTag),
            DistinctActions = dcount(SabotageTag),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmdlines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowSec * 1s)
| where DistinctActions >= 3   // 3 of 5 distinct recovery-kill primitives in a 5-min window
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowSec = 300;
let Tagged = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend SabotageTag = case(
        NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","delete /all"), "vss_delete",
        NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete", "wmic_vss",
        NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "bcd_recovery_off",
        NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"), "wbadmin_delete",
        (NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has "Win32_Shadowcopy", "ps_vss",
        "")
    | where SabotageTag != "";
Tagged
| summarize SabotageActions = make_set(SabotageTag),
            DistinctActions = dcount(SabotageTag),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmdlines = make_set(CommandLine, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowSec * 1s)
| where DistinctActions >= 3   // 3+ distinct recovery-kill tools in a 5-min window
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) ( (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete\ shadows* OR *delete\ /all*)) OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled\ no* OR *bootstatuspolicy\ ignoreallfailures*)) OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete\ catalog* OR *delete\ systemstatebackup*)) OR (@Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*Win32_Shadowcopy*) ) -@User:*$
ucs.rationale: Single sabotage commands (a lone vssadmin delete) are commonly fired by legitimate backup tooling and admin scripts. The LockBit affiliate playbook — documented in CISA AA23-075A, Mandiant tracking of LockBit affiliates, and SecureWorks GOLD MYSTIC reporting — chains 4-6 of these primitives together within a tight window immediately before encryption launch, often from a single batch/PowerShell wr
